payload.explanation: Environment changed since prior observation (revision 2). The original blocker session_45a3f2b48ae6 has rolled back (now idle, ROLLBACK observed) and no longer blocks. The business request (session_9a9b17ccf6a3, pid 490) is now actively waiting on Lock:advisory for pg_advisory_xact_lock(291010), blocked by pid 491 (session_473677f82a4f), which is idle in transaction holding that advisory lock while waiting on ClientRead. The blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids. Query stats confirm the prior UPDATE completed twice (2 calls, 2 rows) and a ROLLBACK occurred, consistent with the old blocker being resolved. Remaining uncertainty: whether session_473677f82a4f's transaction will be released on its own; if it remains abandoned, rollback of that session would be the eligible remediation, but the business request itself must not be modified.
